"""Read-only, scoped coverage. Unknown lifetime totals never become percentages."""
from sqlalchemy import and_, func, select, text
from db.models import Message, OfCreatorBinding
from db.onlyfans_models import OfIngress
from .history_policy import policy, OfOlderHistoryJob
from .store import utcnow


def recent_progress(s, runtime, fan_id=None):
    p = policy(s, runtime.account_id, runtime.binding_id)
    if p is None:
        return None
    from .launch_history_memory.recovery import OfRecentHistoryCursor as C, OfRecentHistoryScan
    filters = [C.account_id == runtime.account_id, C.binding_id == runtime.binding_id]
    scope = [Message.account_id == runtime.account_id, Message.created_at >= p.cutoff_at,
        select(OfIngress.event_key).where(OfIngress.account_id == Message.account_id,
            OfIngress.binding_id == runtime.binding_id, OfIngress.fan_id == Message.fan_id,
            OfIngress.message_id == Message.message_id, OfIngress.status == 'applied').exists()]
    if fan_id is not None:
        filters.append(C.fan_id == fan_id)
        scope.append(Message.fan_id == fan_id)
    counts = dict(s.execute(select(C.status, func.count()).where(*filters).group_by(C.status)).all())
    errors = dict(s.execute(select(C.last_error, func.count()).where(*filters,
        C.last_error.is_not(None)).group_by(C.last_error)).all())
    scan = s.get(OfRecentHistoryScan, runtime.account_id)
    discovery = bool(scan and scan.binding_id == runtime.binding_id and scan.status == 'complete'
                     and scan.known_fans_complete and not scan.last_error)
    # This state describes the initial import, including complete discovery.
    # One completed fan cannot make the account window ready while other
    # conversations are still being discovered (or satisfy the UI contract).
    covered = discovery and (bool(counts) if fan_id is not None else True) and not (
        counts.get('needed', 0) or counts.get('running', 0) or errors)
    total, fans, incoming = s.execute(select(func.count(), func.count(func.distinct(Message.fan_id)),
        func.count().filter(Message.direction == 'in')).where(*scope)).one()
    tenant = s.scalar(select(OfCreatorBinding.tenant_id).where(OfCreatorBinding.id==runtime.binding_id))
    params = {'tenant':tenant,'account':runtime.account_id,'binding':runtime.binding_id,'cutoff':p.cutoff_at,'fan':fan_id}
    # Same source-fingerprint receipts as the paid learner, including fact-free results.
    pending = s.scalar(text('''SELECT count(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.account_id=:account
        AND m.created_at>=:cutoff AND m.direction='in' AND (:fan IS NULL OR m.fan_id=:fan)
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM of_ingress i WHERE i.account_id=m.account_id AND i.binding_id=:binding
            AND i.fan_id=m.fan_id AND i.message_id=m.message_id AND i.status='applied')
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM of_profile_receipts r WHERE r.tenant_id=:tenant AND r.account_id=m.account_id
            AND r.binding_id=:binding AND r.fan_id=m.fan_id AND r.source_fan=m.fan_id
            AND r.message_id=m.message_id AND r.body_md5=md5(m.body) AND r.source_at=m.created_at
            AND r.direction=m.direction AND r.unsent=m.is_unsent AND r.automation=coalesce(m.automation_kind,'')
            AND r.next_chunk=r.total_chunks)'''),params)
    old = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(OfOlderHistoryJob).where(
        OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id == runtime.account_id, OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id == runtime.binding_id,
        True if fan_id is None else OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id == fan_id))
    from .launch_history_memory.recovery import OfHistoryCursor as L, OfHistoryScan
    lifetime_scan = s.get(OfHistoryScan, runtime.account_id)
    lifetime_states = dict(s.execute(select(L.status,func.count()).where(
        L.account_id==runtime.account_id,L.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,
        True if fan_id is None else L.fan_id==fan_id).group_by(L.status)).all())
    lifetime_complete = bool(lifetime_states) and not (lifetime_states.get('needed',0) or lifetime_states.get('running',0))
    if fan_id is None:
        from db.models import Fan
        missing = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Fan).where(Fan.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            ~select(L.fan_id).where(L.account_id==Fan.account_id,L.fan_id==Fan.fan_id,L.binding_id==runtime.binding_id).exists()))
        lifetime_complete = bool(lifetime_complete and lifetime_scan and lifetime_scan.status=='complete'
            and lifetime_scan.known_fans_complete and not missing)
    older_done = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(OfOlderHistoryJob).join(L,and_(
        L.account_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id,L.fan_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id,
        L.binding_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id)).where(OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id==runtime.account_id,
        OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,L.status=='complete',
        True if fan_id is None else OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id==fan_id))
    hold = s.execute(text('''SELECT hold_code,hold_until FROM of_profile_accounts
        WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND account_id=:account AND binding_id=:binding'''),params).first()
    active_hold = bool(hold and hold[1] and str(hold[1]) > str(utcnow()))
    memory_errors = s.scalar(text('''SELECT count(*) FROM of_profile_learning WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND account_id=:account
        AND binding_id=:binding AND fan_id>0 AND (:fan IS NULL OR fan_id=:fan) AND error_code IS NOT NULL'''),params)
    from .history_telemetry import OfHistoryReadAttempt as A
    attempts, http_attempts, failed, unfinished = s.execute(select(func.count(),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(A.http_attempts),0),func.count().filter(A.outcome=='failed'),
        func.count().filter(A.outcome=='unfinished')).where(A.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            A.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,A.scope=='recent',
            True if fan_id is None else A.fan_id==fan_id)).one()
    from db.models import GrokCall
    from .profile_learning.accounting import metadata
    from decimal import Decimal
    billing = {k:0 for k in ['providerReportedUnits','tokenEstimateUnits','activeReservationUnits','unresolvedReservationUnits']}
    model_ms = 0
    for call in s.scalars(select(GrokCall).where(GrokCall.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            GrokCall.purpose=='gen_info',GrokCall.called_at>=p.started_at,
            True if fan_id is None else GrokCall.fan_id==fan_id)):
        meta = metadata(call)
        bucket = ('activeReservationUnits' if call.status=='pending' else
            'unresolvedReservationUnits' if call.status=='unknown' else
            'providerReportedUnits' if meta.get('billing') in {'provider_reported_cost','provider_reconciled'} else 'tokenEstimateUnits')
        billing[bucket] += call.cost_cents or 0
        model_ms += call.latency_ms or 0
    accounting = {k.replace('Units','Usd'):str(Decimal(v)/10000) for k,v in billing.items()}
    receipt_first, receipt_last = s.execute(text("""SELECT min(processed_at),max(processed_at) FROM of_profile_receipts
        WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND account_id=:account AND binding_id=:binding AND fan_id>0
        AND source_at>=:cutoff AND processed_at>=:started AND (:fan IS NULL OR fan_id=:fan)"""),{**params,'started':p.started_at}).one()
    accounting.update(scope='account memory calls since fixed policy start, including activated older jobs',
        cumulativeModelCallMilliseconds=model_ms)
    completed_at = s.scalar(select(func.max(C.completed_at)).where(*filters)) if covered else None
    from .history_policy import approved_onboarding
    onboarding = approved_onboarding(s, runtime.account_id, runtime.binding_id)
    return {'creatorOnboarding':{'state':'approved' if onboarding else 'review_required','routineCreatorArchiveExtraction':'disabled'},
        'schemaVersion':'of-recent-history.v1', 'startedAt':p.started_at.isoformat()+'Z',
        'cutoffAt':p.cutoff_at.isoformat()+'Z', 'retentionPolicy':'preserve_all_stored_data',
        'initialHistory':{'state':'recent_history_ready' if covered else 'incomplete',
            'discoveryComplete':discovery,'discoveryPasses':scan.pass_number if scan else 0,
            'discoveryError':scan.last_error if scan else None,
            'conversationsDiscovered':sum(counts.values()),'conversationsReady':counts.get('complete',0),
            'conversationsAwaitingWork':counts.get('needed',0)+counts.get('running',0),
            'messagesSavedInWindow':total,'fansWithStoredWindowMessages':fans,'providerErrors':errors,
            'completedAt':completed_at.isoformat()+'Z' if completed_at else None,
            'elapsedSeconds':max(0,((completed_at or utcnow())-p.started_at).total_seconds()),
            'providerOrdering':'verified_timestamp_desc' if p.timestamp_order_verified else 'id_desc_exhaustive_date_filter',
            'orderingEvidence':p.ordering_evidence,
            'providerRequests':int(http_attempts), 'pageReadAttempts':attempts, 'failedReadAttempts':failed,
            'unfinishedReadAttempts':unfinished, 'providerRequestMeasurement':'HTTP attempts counted at dispatch, including identity probes and failures'},
        'memoryProcessing':{'state':'ready' if covered and pending==0 and not active_hold and not memory_errors else 'incomplete',
            'incomingMessagesInWindow':incoming,'messagesProcessed':incoming-pending,'messagesAwaitingProcessing':pending,
            'firstCurrentRunReceiptAt':str(receipt_first) if receipt_first else None,
            'lastCurrentRunReceiptAt':str(receipt_last) if receipt_last else None,
            'receiptIntervalMeasurement':'wall interval between committed memory receipts; cumulative model latency is separate',
            'errors':memory_errors, 'budgetHold':hold[0] if active_hold else None,
            'completionDoesNotMeanLifetimeHistory':True},
        'memoryModelAccounting':accounting,
        'lifetimeHistory':{'complete':lifetime_complete,'conversationsComplete':lifetime_states.get('complete',0)},
        'olderHistory':{'activatedFanJobs':old,'completedFanJobs':older_done,'pendingFanJobs':old-older_done,'scheduler':'bounded existing archive lane'},
        'lifetimeTotalMessages':None,'percentComplete':None}

"""Read-only private snapshots separate reused work from a subsequent pilot run.

Snapshots contain source fingerprints and call IDs, never message text. Keep them
on the operational host. No model/provider requests, activation, DDL or deletion.
"""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import func, select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from db.models import Message, GrokCall
from db.onlyfans_models import OfIngress
from onlyfans_runtime.history_policy import policy
from onlyfans_runtime.history_telemetry import OfHistoryReadAttempt
from onlyfans_runtime.profile_learning.accounting import metadata
from onlyfans_runtime.store import Store, Refused

SCHEMA = 'of-history-pilot-snapshot.v1'


def capture(store, tenant, account):
    with store.engine.connect().execution_options(isolation_level='REPEATABLE READ') as connection:
        with Session(bind=connection) as s, s.begin():
            runtime = store._runtime(s, tenant, account, lock=False)
            p = policy(s, account, runtime.binding_id)
            if p is None: raise Refused('recent-history policy is not active')
            scope = [Message.account_id == account, Message.created_at >= p.cutoff_at,
                select(OfIngress.event_key).where(OfIngress.account_id == account,
                    OfIngress.binding_id == runtime.binding_id, OfIngress.status == 'applied',
                    OfIngress.fan_id == Message.fan_id, OfIngress.message_id == Message.message_id).exists()]
            sources = {}
            for fan, mid, at, direction, unsent, automation, body_hash in s.execute(select(
                    Message.fan_id, Message.message_id, Message.created_at, Message.direction,
                    Message.is_unsent, Message.automation_kind, func.md5(Message.body)).where(*scope)):
                key = hashlib.sha256(f'{account}:{fan}:{mid}'.encode()).hexdigest()
                digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([str(at), direction, unsent, automation or '', body_hash]).encode()).hexdigest()
                sources[key] = digest
            # The same fingerprint conditions used by the paid learner and progress report.
            receipts = {}
            for fan, mid, at in s.execute(text('''SELECT m.fan_id,m.message_id,r.processed_at
                FROM messages m JOIN of_profile_receipts r ON r.tenant_id=:tenant AND r.account_id=m.account_id
                AND r.binding_id=:binding AND r.fan_id=m.fan_id AND r.source_fan=m.fan_id
                AND r.message_id=m.message_id AND r.body_md5=md5(m.body) AND r.source_at=m.created_at
                AND r.direction=m.direction AND r.unsent=m.is_unsent
                AND r.automation=coalesce(m.automation_kind,'') AND r.next_chunk=r.total_chunks
                WHERE m.account_id=:account AND m.created_at>=:cutoff AND m.direction='in'
                AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM of_ingress i WHERE i.account_id=m.account_id
                    AND i.binding_id=:binding AND i.fan_id=m.fan_id AND i.message_id=m.message_id
                    AND i.status='applied')'''), {'tenant':tenant,'account':account,'binding':runtime.binding_id,'cutoff':p.cutoff_at}):
                key = hashlib.sha256(f'{account}:{fan}:{mid}'.encode()).hexdigest()
                receipts[key] = {'digest': sources[key], 'committedAt': str(at)}
            calls = {}
            for call in s.scalars(select(GrokCall).where(GrokCall.account_id == account, GrokCall.purpose == 'gen_info')):
                billing = metadata(call).get('billing')
                bucket = ('activeReservationUnits' if call.status == 'pending' else
                    'unresolvedReservationUnits' if call.status == 'unknown' else
                    'providerReportedUnits' if billing in {'provider_reported_cost','provider_reconciled'} else 'tokenEstimateUnits')
                calls[str(call.id)] = {'bucket':bucket,'units':call.cost_cents or 0,'latencyMs':call.latency_ms or 0}
            attempts = s.scalar(select(func.coalesce(func.sum(OfHistoryReadAttempt.http_attempts),0)).where(
                OfHistoryReadAttempt.account_id == account, OfHistoryReadAttempt.binding_id == runtime.binding_id,
                OfHistoryReadAttempt.scope == 'recent'))
            return {'schemaVersion':SCHEMA,'observedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                'accountId':account,'bindingId':runtime.binding_id,'cutoffAt':p.cutoff_at.isoformat(),
                'sources':sources,'receipts':receipts,'modelCalls':calls,'recentHttpAttempts':int(attempts)}


def compare(before, after):
    for key in ['schemaVersion','accountId','bindingId','cutoffAt']:
        if before.get(key) != after.get(key): raise ValueError('snapshot scope changed: '+key)
    if before.get('schemaVersion') != SCHEMA: raise ValueError('invalid snapshot schema')
    start,end = (datetime.fromisoformat(x['observedAt']) for x in [before,after])
    if end < start: raise ValueError('snapshots reversed')
    old,new = before['sources'],after['sources']
    old_r,new_r = before['receipts'],after['receipts']
    reused = {k for k,v in new.items() if old.get(k) == v}
    completed = {k for k,v in new_r.items() if old_r.get(k,{}).get('digest') != v['digest']}
    changed_old_calls = {k for k,v in after['modelCalls'].items() if k in before['modelCalls'] and before['modelCalls'][k] != v}
    new_calls = {k:v for k,v in after['modelCalls'].items() if k not in before['modelCalls']}
    def totals(calls):
        result = {k:0 for k in ['providerReportedUnits','tokenEstimateUnits','activeReservationUnits','unresolvedReservationUnits']}
        for c in calls: result[c['bucket']] += c['units']
        return result
    committed = [datetime.fromisoformat(new_r[k]['committedAt']) for k in completed]
    previous = totals(before['modelCalls'][k] for k in changed_old_calls)
    current = totals(after['modelCalls'][k] for k in changed_old_calls)
    return {'schemaVersion':'of-history-pilot-comparison.v1','accountId':after['accountId'],
        'basis':'Observed pilot with reused archive; not fresh creator onboarding performance',
        'observedElapsedSeconds':(end-start).total_seconds(),
        'existingWindowSourcesAtStart':len(old),'unchangedExistingWindowSourcesReused':len(reused),
        'newWindowSourcesSaved':len(set(new)-set(old)),
        'existingWindowSourcesEdited':sum(k in old and old[k]!=v for k,v in new.items()),
        'baselineSourcesNoLongerInScope':len(set(old)-set(new)),
        'reusedCompletedIncomingReceipts':sum(old_r.get(k,{}).get('digest')==v['digest'] for k,v in new_r.items()),
        'newlyCompletedIncomingReceipts':len(completed),
        'newlyCompletedReceiptsForReusedSources':len(completed & reused),
        'newReceiptCommitSpanSeconds':(max(committed)-min(committed)).total_seconds() if committed else None,
        'receiptSpanIsNotTotalMemoryProcessingTime':True,
        'newRecentProviderHttpAttempts':after['recentHttpAttempts']-before['recentHttpAttempts'],
        'newModelCalls':len(new_calls),'newModelCallAmounts':totals(new_calls.values()),
        'amountUsdPerUnit':'0.0001',
        'preExistingModelCallSettlementChanges':{k:current[k]-previous[k] for k in current},
        'cumulativeNewModelCallLatencyMs':sum(c['latencyMs'] for c in new_calls.values()),
        'newSourcesIncludeConcurrentLiveArrivals':True,
        'fullHistoryTimeOrCostSavingsDemonstrated':False}


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--account', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--save-snapshot', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--compare-with', type=Path)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    before=json.loads(args.compare_with.read_text()) if args.compare_with else None
    store=Store(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'])
    try: snapshot=capture(store,os.environ['ONLYFANS_WORKER_TENANT'],args.account)
    finally: store.close()
    # Exclusive creation prevents accidental destruction of the before evidence.
    fd=os.open(args.save_snapshot,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as stream: json.dump(snapshot,stream)
    print(json.dumps(compare(before,snapshot) if before else {
        'accountId':args.account,'baselineCaptured':True,'windowSources':len(snapshot['sources']),
        'completedIncomingReceipts':len(snapshot['receipts']),'modelCallRecords':len(snapshot['modelCalls'])},indent=2))

if __name__=='__main__': main()

"""Reused sources, edits, reservations and earlier settlements stay distinct."""
import copy
import pytest
from tools.history_pilot_measurement import SCHEMA, compare, capture
from test_onlyfans_foundation_pg import database
from test_recent_history_onboarding_pg import ready, event, T, A


def baseline():
    return {'schemaVersion':SCHEMA,'accountId':'a','bindingId':'b','cutoffAt':'2026-10-03',
        'observedAt':'2026-11-02T00:00:00+00:00','sources':{'existing':'v1','edited':'old'},
        'receipts':{'existing':{'digest':'v1','committedAt':'2026-10-31 00:00:00'}},
        'modelCalls':{'earlier':{'bucket':'unresolvedReservationUnits','units':30,'latencyMs':0}},
        'recentHttpAttempts':100}


def test_rerun_does_not_claim_existing_sources_or_old_settlements_as_new_work():
    before=baseline();after=copy.deepcopy(before);after['observedAt']='2026-11-02T00:02:00+00:00'
    after['sources'].update(edited='new',fresh='f1')
    after['receipts']['fresh']={'digest':'f1','committedAt':'2026-11-02 00:01:00'}
    after['modelCalls']['earlier']={'bucket':'providerReportedUnits','units':5,'latencyMs':10}
    after['modelCalls']['new']={'bucket':'providerReportedUnits','units':2,'latencyMs':100}
    after['modelCalls']['pending']={'bucket':'activeReservationUnits','units':10,'latencyMs':0}
    after['recentHttpAttempts']=104
    result=compare(before,after)
    assert result['existingWindowSourcesAtStart']==2
    assert result['unchangedExistingWindowSourcesReused']==1
    assert result['newWindowSourcesSaved']==1
    assert result['existingWindowSourcesEdited']==1
    assert result['reusedCompletedIncomingReceipts']==1
    assert result['newlyCompletedIncomingReceipts']==1
    assert result['newModelCallAmounts']['providerReportedUnits']==2
    assert result['newModelCallAmounts']['activeReservationUnits']==10
    assert result['preExistingModelCallSettlementChanges']['providerReportedUnits']==5
    assert result['preExistingModelCallSettlementChanges']['unresolvedReservationUnits']==-30
    assert result['newRecentProviderHttpAttempts']==4
    assert result['observedElapsedSeconds']==120
    assert result['cumulativeNewModelCallLatencyMs']==100
    assert result['fullHistoryTimeOrCostSavingsDemonstrated'] is False


def test_changed_binding_or_cutoff_and_reversed_snapshots_are_refused():
    before=baseline()
    for key,value in [('bindingId','different'),('cutoffAt','different'),('observedAt','2026-11-01T00:00:00+00:00')]:
        after=copy.deepcopy(before);after[key]=value
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):compare(before,after)


def test_private_capture_reads_current_binding_and_reports_new_sources(ready):
    store,recovery,engine,cutoff=ready
    before=capture(store,T,A)
    claim=recovery.claim(T,A)
    recovery.page(T,claim,[event(20,cutoff,body='Private synthetic text')],has_more=False)
    after=capture(store,T,A)
    result=compare(before,after)
    assert result['newWindowSourcesSaved']==1
    assert result['newModelCalls']==0
    assert 'Private synthetic text' not in str(after)
    assert all(len(k)==64 for k in after['sources'])


def test_receipts_from_another_tenant_do_not_complete_this_tenants_memory(ready):
    from sqlalchemy import text
    from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
    from db.onlyfans_models import OfRuntime
    from onlyfans_runtime.history_progress import recent_progress
    store,recovery,engine,cutoff=ready
    claim=recovery.claim(T,A)
    recovery.page(T,claim,[event(20,cutoff)],has_more=False)
    with engine.begin() as db:
        for tenant in ['other-tenant', T]:
            db.execute(text('''INSERT INTO of_profile_learning(tenant_id,account_id,binding_id,fan_id)
                SELECT :tenant,account_id,binding_id,101 FROM of_runtime WHERE account_id=:account
                ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING'''), {'tenant':tenant,'account':A})
        db.execute(text('''INSERT INTO of_profile_receipts(tenant_id,account_id,binding_id,fan_id,
            source_fan,message_id,body_md5,source_at,direction,unsent,automation,next_chunk,total_chunks)
            SELECT 'other-tenant',m.account_id,r.binding_id,m.fan_id,m.fan_id,m.message_id,
            md5(m.body),m.created_at,m.direction,m.is_unsent,coalesce(m.automation_kind,''),1,1
            FROM messages m JOIN of_runtime r ON r.account_id=m.account_id
            WHERE m.account_id=:account AND m.message_id=20'''), {'account':A})
    assert capture(store,T,A)['receipts']=={}
    with Session(engine) as db:
        result=recent_progress(db,db.get(OfRuntime,A))
        assert result['memoryProcessing']['messagesAwaitingProcessing']==1
    with engine.begin() as db:
        db.execute(text('''INSERT INTO of_profile_receipts SELECT :tenant,account_id,binding_id,
            fan_id,source_fan,message_id,body_md5,source_at,direction,unsent,automation,
            next_chunk,total_chunks,processed_at FROM of_profile_receipts
            WHERE tenant_id='other-tenant' AND account_id=:account'''), {'tenant':T,'account':A})
    assert len(capture(store,T,A)['receipts'])==1
    with Session(engine) as db:
        assert recent_progress(db,db.get(OfRuntime,A))['memoryProcessing']['messagesAwaitingProcessing']==0
